Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of aluminum film as α_f = 23.1 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of the ceramic substrate as α_s = 8 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use a temperature change of ΔT = -180 K.
Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain as (α_f - α_s) × ΔT.
The thermal-mismatch strain in the film is approximately -2.72 × 10⁻³, which is compressive.
